project_type: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript application (AI Game Development Platform v3.0)
build_system: Bun (bun.lock, no npm/yarn). Scripts: bun run build, bun run dev, bun test:run
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, vitest.setup.ts, path alias @/ resolved to project root
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run type-check to ensure no TS errors. 2. Run bun run test:run to ensure all tests pass. 3. Run bun run lint to check linting.
environment_constraints: No Docker available. Network is COMMON_DEPENDENCIES. TypeScript strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters. Project uses @/* path alias resolving to project root.
contribution_requirements: Use Bun instead of Node.js/npm/pnpm. Follow existing patterns in the codebase.
key_patterns: API routes in app/api/ use Next.js App Router conventions. Existing createApiHandler wrapper in lib/middleware/api.ts provides auth, validation, rate-limiting. Logger is a singleton from lib/logging/logger.ts. Redis via @upstash/redis in lib/cache/client.ts. Database via @neondatabase/serverless in lib/db/client.ts. Auth via @stackframe/stack in lib/auth/session.ts. Roles in session.ts are admin|creator|viewer but permissions.ts uses admin|editor|viewer (mismatch). Console statements use [v0] prefix instead of structured logger.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. lib/ - Core library code (auth, cache, config, db, agents, workflow, logging, monitoring, validation). components/ - React UI components. scripts/db/ - SQL migration scripts. vitest.config.ts - Test configuration.
